method: Recursive filename, text and JSON-field patterns

initial_sensitive_finding: One kubeconfig with embedded client credential material found in the older local release. Removed from this upload before Git initialization; no duplicate credential values found.
excluded_from_upload: Superseded editorial change log and style-count supplement

allowed_placeholder.description: Example environment assignment uses literal your-google-ai-api-key, not a credential.

review_release_scope: Published aggregate matrix and counts only; approved pseudonymous methods/disclosures remain in manuscript.
email_review: Only author public contact and upstream project/tool attribution contacts; no reviewer identity/contact found.
limitations: Pattern and provenance checks do not prove absence of every possible secret or identifying free-text statement. Private review directories, original returns, correspondence and blinding keys are excluded wholesale.
